_doc: #284 (ADR 0006): this line is unplayable until ported; its cards are kept for the line's skill tests. A card is on offer to every job on the line of its requires.jobs (UpgradePool.on_line), weapons gate no card, and the carried-attack and advancement-draw rules below are gone. Warrior line cards (job 100; spec #151 ticket #163), followed by the second-job cards of spec #165: per skill a learn and a rank card (Final Attack and Booster ones are power cards, the Final Attack also has a Spread card), each listing only its own branch in requires.jobs (110, 120 or 130) and offered only while the held weapon family is the skill's (#181-#184; docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 7.9-7.12). Card format and tier rules: see ../upgrades.json _doc. Every first-job card requires job 100 (the ten Power Strike and Slash Blast cards also list requires.carry_jobs [110, 120, 130] (spec #165 #180, owner decision: Warrior second job has no attack skills): they stay eligible after the second job, stay power cards, and are never in the advancement draw, which matches requires.jobs only; Iron Body and the two HP passives stop at Lv 30) and, through its skill, a held weapon the skill can use (UpgradePool: Power Strike and Slash Blast need a Warrior melee family). Rarity is the shared Potential table (upgrades.json rarity and magnitudes): learn cards start at the tier's rank, rank cards gain its ranks, modifier cards stack its steps. Offer weights, step sizes and maxima below are tier C (ours, untuned until the balance pass); canonical skill caps are tier A. Extra targets come only from the target cards (the canonical Power Strike hits 1 monster, Slash Blast up to its mobCount 6).
